title: Enable or disable promiscuous mode on a network interface
summary: Turn promiscuous mode on or off. In promiscuous mode, the interface captures all traffic on the network segment, not just traffic addressed to it.

steps.explain: Use `sudo ip link set` with the `promisc` option to turn promiscuous mode on or off.

placeholders.name: INTERFACE
placeholders.description: The name of the network interface.

placeholders.name: STATE
placeholders.description: The state: 'on' to enable, 'off' to disable.

alternatives.explain: Use the short form `sudo ip l s`.

rollback.explain: To disable promiscuous mode, set it to 'off'.

warnings: Promiscuous mode can increase CPU load and may have security implications.
